_about: W2-PROCESS rules. `stations`: placed kinds that run process jobs in the world (inputs leave the bag, sit on the station, finish on the wall clock while the player is away or offline, outputs wait on the station until collected). `recipes` per station: recipe ids from recipes.json with the station duration in real seconds (overrides recipes.json `seconds`, which stays the old stand-and-craft time). `stages`: progress thresholds that pick a props_manifest buildings.<kind>.stages[].id model. `fx`: smoke|steam emitter while a job runs. `spoil`: seconds until a food stack spoils, first matching category wins; `keeps` categories never spoil. `item_buffs`: food that carries a buff (rows in `buffs`, same shape as food_buffs.json). `steam_cap`: most times one dish can be steamed. Timings and spoil times are # ASSUMPTION values (spec 11 lists Durango:0 delegated times as unverified); tune here.
